name: dotenv-linter
description: dotenv-linter — linter for .env files. Checks for formatting issues, duplicates, alphabetization, and security concerns.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/dotenv-linter/dotenv-linter/releases/download/v3.3.0/dotenv-linter-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && tar xzf dotenv-linter-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && sudo mv dotenv-linter /usr/local/bin/ && rm dotenv-linter-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.

commands.description: dotenv-linter — linter for .env files. Checks for formatting issues, duplicates, alphabetization, and security concerns.
